description: The self-diagnostic from mikefluff.com/diagnostic: ten multiple-choice questions about how a business runs, scored into one of five named operational conditions (e.g. "one queue, one person", "manual conveyor", "SaaS obesity") with a severity, an annual cost estimate built only from the user's own answers, and a recommended next step with its URL. Call it with answers = {} first to get the questionnaire (question ids, option ids, which questions are conditional), ask the user, then call again with {questionId: optionId} (an array of option ids for multiple-choice questions). Read-only: nothing is stored or mailed.

answers.description: Question id → option id, or option ids for a multiple-choice question. {} returns the questionnaire.

locale.description: Language of the result: en, ru, pt or es.

name: run_diagnostic
title: Run the business diagnostic
